_comment: Canonical Starstone rank ladder. Ratings are Glicko-2 centred at 1000 (see Backend/supabase_setup_mmr_additive_only.sql). Trainee is a PLACEMENT state, not a rating band, so a player who has a bad week is never permanently labelled a beginner. Bands are absolute thresholds, never a position against other players -- a rank that moves because other people played is not a record.
